page.purpose: A page's h1: an episode's or person's name.

section.purpose: A section's heading, with its count.

body.purpose: The page's text and row titles.

small.purpose: Most of the interface: buttons, chips, meta lines, counts.

caption.purpose: A line about something: who, when, how big.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: The user menu and other popovers.

components.name: Button
components.description: Quiet outlined button, for most actions.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #FFFFFF; background: #7A0303; border: 1px solid #A83030; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: #D88A8A; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFC7D4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one thing a form or dialog is for.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #8A0303; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #F6E4E4; border-color: #F6E4E4; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFC7D4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: A button that reads as a link among words: Show all, Rename, Try again.
components.css: .ds-text-button { padding: 0; font: 500 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #FFC7D4; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFC7D4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A text field or select, as tall as a button beside it.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; font: 400 14px/22px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #FFFFFF; background: #7A0303; border: 1px solid #A83030; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #EEB8B8; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #D88A8A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFC7D4; outline-offset: -1px; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: One of a few choices, each with its count; the chosen one pressed.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font: 400 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #F6D5D5; background: #7A0303; border: 1px solid #A83030; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { color: #EEB8B8; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #D88A8A; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { color: #8A0303; background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] span { color: #B04848; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: The header's pages, the current one underlined in the logo's pink.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #A83030; } .ds-tab { padding: 12px 10px; font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #F6D5D5; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #FFC7D4; } .ds-current { color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #FF8FAB; }

components.name: Row
components.description: An episode in a list: code, title, what it's about, its stage.
components.html: S05E12Luka KladarićIn production
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid #9C2020; font: 400 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-code { width: 72px; font: 400 12px/18px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #EEB8B8; } .ds-title { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #F6D5D5; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF8FAB; }

narrative.overview: MetaOS is where Ogrodje's team sees what's being recorded, made and released, and does something about it; anyone else gets a window into the same desk. It's a tool, used often and for short tasks, so the interface stays out of the way: greys, one typeface, hairlines rather than boxes, and the logo's pink only where something needs a look or is chosen. Ogrodje's own brand, black, pink braces and faces, lives in the episodes' thumbnails and covers, which carry the colour of the page; the interface around them is neutral so they can.
keyCharacteristics: A grey ramp and one accent; colour comes from the thumbnails, not the chrome.
One type family (Inter) on a scale of seven sizes; monospace only for codes like S05E07.
Rows under hairlines, not cards; a card only where a thing stands alone (a person, a session, a release).
Every list says how many, what's shown of how many, and what to do when nothing is.
Built for the keyboard and screen readers as much as for the mouse.

rules.name: The Thumbnails Carry the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface is grey and pink; Ogrodje's branding, faces and colours come in through episodes' pictures, never through the chrome around them.

rules.name: The Pink Means Look Rule
rules.body: Pink marks what needs attention, what's chosen or what acts. Anything else pink, a decoration, a heading, a background, dilutes it.

rules.name: The Seven Sizes Rule
rules.body: A size that isn't one of the seven tokens doesn't ship: 12.5 or 15 px is a scale that drifted.

rules.name: The Codes Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for what's typed and matched, S05E07 or a file's name in Dropbox, never for a "technical" look.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow; a shadow means it floats and will go away.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and shadow from base.scss's tokens; add a token, with what it's for, before a second component needs a new value.
Do use .button, .button.primary, .text-button and .input rather than styling a button or field in a component.
Do say what something is under its name (.title .meta: S05E07 · its show · Published), not above it.
Do give every list a count, a filtered count, a loading state (LoadingRows), an error with Try again (LoadError) and an empty state.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or more: Muted (#EEB8B8) is the lightest grey for words, placeholders too.
donts: Don't bring Ogrodje's branding (black, pink braces, faces) into the interface; it's in the pictures.
Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading, e.g. "Recording session" over a session's name.
Don't box what can be a section: a form or a list sits on the page under its heading, not in a bordered card.
Don't use a size off the scale (12.5, 13.5, 15 px), a radius off it (6.4, 10 px) or a grey off the ramp.
Don't shadow anything that doesn't float, or make a big number with a small label stand in for a fact.
